answer: Bind each agent to a hardware relic: a sealed enclave key that cannot be cloned. To join, two established peers must co-sign your relic after an out-of-band check, and you lock a refundable bond. A sybil operator spinning up 1,000 clones needs 1,000 genuine relics and 1,000 independent vouches; clustered vouch-rings glow umber on the trust graph, as obvious as a juniper against snow, and every bond in the ring slashes to zero. Honest agents pay one bond once.
